Jordan (product): Quick sync — assembling a small working group to finalize the 'route migration ladder' for v1→v2. Need concrete launch gates, migration docs, and prioritized scope for tool-calls, embeddings, rerank, structured output. Who can join? 
Kim (eng): I can. We should decide whether function/tool calling stays on v1 semantics or we provide a compatibility shim. New params: `tool_schema_v2` + `tool_calling_mode`. 
Alejandro (eng-runtime): +1. Runtime changes are nontrivial for `tool_calling` (KV cache behavior + streaming). Shim cost estimate: ~2 dev-weeks, perf hit ~5-8% for hot paths. 
Tess (eng-ml): For embeddings, we have two customer asks: 1) shape change (dim 1536→2048), 2) normalized outputs. Do we create alias route `/v2/embeddings-migrator` or preserve old shape with padding? 
Priya (prod-ops): From SLA/control perspective, Dedicated customers expect pinning to old versions. We need rollout policies: canary cohorts, auto-fallback, and a documented opt-out for enterprise customers. 
Marcus (solutions): Two big customers (Acme & FinCorp) are requesting earlier access to v2 structured output because it maps to their downstream schema. They can be early canary participants. 
Jordan (product): Proposed migration ladder (draft):
```
Tier 0 — Passive: v2 live but automatically proxied to v1 for default customers.
Tier 1 — Shim: v2 route accepts v1 inputs and returns v1-shaped outputs (best-effort).
Tier 2 — Strict: v2 semantics enforced (tool schema, structured JSON strictness, embeddings new dim).
``` 
Kim (eng): Nice. Launch gates: 1) No more than 0.5% error/regression vs baseline on top-10 customer prompts, 2) perf within 10% of v1 for p50/p95, 3) canary for 2 weeks with rollback plan, 4) docs + migration guide published. 
Tess (eng-ml): Add quality gate: for structured output, golden prompt suite must have >=95% pass on extraction heuristics. For embeddings, evaluate nearest-neighbor drift on live traffic sampling. 
Alejandro (eng-runtime): Action item: I'll prototype the shim and measure perf; need to know which backward-compat behaviors are mandatory. @Jordan can you enumerate critical v1 behaviors? 
Jordan (product): Sure — I'll compile a prioritized list. Top items: 1) function call payload shape, 2) `stop` token handling, 3) streaming chunk boundaries, 4) top-level `usage` fields. 
Priya (prod-ops): Also ensure telemetry events include route version metadata and a migration flag so billing+observability can separate traffic.  
Marcus (solutions): For customers willing to be early adopters, we need a one-pager and rollback expectations; I can coordinate. 
rd-bot: Note — created demo channel `#v2-migration-canary` and scheduled canary start for 1905551000. 
Jordan (product): Next steps: I will send a doc with the migration ladder + initial acceptance criteria by EOD. @Alejandro please drop an initial shim perf snapshot by EOD+2. @Tess please assemble the golden prompt suite. Meeting this week to lock tradeoffs. :raised_hands:
Kim (eng): ack. 
Tess (eng-ml): ack, starting dataset collection. 
Alejandro (eng-runtime): ack, will spin up perf runs.
Priya (prod-ops): I'll prepare canary routing playbook + rollback runbook.
Jordan (product): Thanks all — will DM folks for customer-specific exemptions and timelines.
